artifacts.description: Declared model instances and contribution roles

claim.scope_statement: For r=floor(ell/2), k>=3 and ell>=2, explicit nonnegative degree-2k polynomials have exactly (10*floor(k/3)^2)^r*k^(ell-2r) isolated real zeros, giving liminf N(k,ell)/k^ell >= (10/9)^r. Includes a fully verified rational ten-zero sextic, N(k,1)=k, N(1,ell)=1, a general (2k-1)^ell upper bound, and the known N(2,2)=4 and N(3,2)=10 using the credited published planar upper bound. Does not determine the sharp general asymptotic constant.

evidence.note: Each declared model instance and its exact contribution role is preserved in files/attribution.json; no authorship or independent verification is inferred from the intake summary.
